quest.5130110342A53FEB.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Quantify Key (storagedrawers:quantify_key). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130110342A53FEB.title: Obtain 1 × Quantify Key
quest.51301103E224F47D.quest_desc: A Drawer Key locks a drawer’s assignment. Insert the intended item, then apply the key; the locked drawer remembers its type even when empty.
This is useful before feeding a mixed resource stream automatically. The key controls item assignment rather than other players’ permissions: a locked drawer is not a private safe.
quest.51301103E224F47D.title: Obtain 1 × Drawer Key
quest.51301104CFA9A015.quest_desc: An EnderStorage Ender Chest provides an item channel between distant locations. Set the same three-colour combination on both chests and confirm shared contents with one inexpensive item.

Add extraction at the receiving end for a continuous stream. The shared channel has finite inventory and fills if the second chest is not unloaded. Before sending valuables, also check who else uses that channel.
quest.51301104CFA9A015.title: Obtain 1 × Ender Chest
quest.51301111F4AEB3F2.quest_desc: The Trash Can permanently removes unwanted items. Put it at the end of a dedicated waste branch after separating resources you want to keep.
Test the filtering with an inexpensive sample and retain a storage route for useful items. A Trash Can is not an overflow buffer whose contents can be retrieved later.
quest.51301111F4AEB3F2.title: Obtain 1 × Trash Can
quest.513011167EADAFD9.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Angel Block (extrautilitiesreborn:angel_block). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011167EADAFD9.title: Obtain 1 × Angel Block
quest.5130111899C7AD4E.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Ender Generator (extrautilitiesreborn:ender_generator). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130111899C7AD4E.title: Obtain 1 × Ender Generator
quest.51301119B9DEEAF8.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Concealment Key (storagedrawers:shroud_key). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301119B9DEEAF8.title: Obtain 1 × Concealment Key
quest.5130111C4CD728C6.quest_desc: This Iron Chest belongs to Sophisticated Storage. Craft it from a wooden chest or upgrade a copper one; JEI shows both routes, so the copper branch is optional.
The chest increases inventory slots; functional upgrades add separate capabilities. Hold one chest before placement. Detection consumes nothing and accepts any wood variant.

Gold Chest follows Precision Mechanism. Chapter 37 teaches Tier Upgrades and the Controller network. A container tier upgrade and a Stack Upgrade serve different purposes: the latter increases capacity per slot.
quest.5130111C4CD728C6.title: Iron Chest: Your Storage Foundation
quest.51301126FAF56F13.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Golden Bag of Holding (extrautilitiesreborn:golden_bag_of_holding). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301126FAF56F13.title: Obtain 1 × Golden Bag of Holding
quest.5130113706F7FC90.quest_desc: This Sophisticated Storage tier starts with a gold chest. Its Quantum Processor requires Dimensional Matrix; an early storage setup does not need to wait for this later upgrade.
Craft a Diamond Chest or apply Gold to Diamond Tier Upgrade to a placed container. Check the recipe for a single or double chest: their costs differ.

The item task detects one diamond chest without consuming it. Matter Condenser uses a separate Gold to Diamond Tier Upgrade. Expand slot capacity with Stack Upgrades, or move on to netherite after the Moon expedition.
quest.5130113706F7FC90.title: Diamond Chest: More Inventory Slots
quest.5130113B8DF6EC22.quest_desc: For bulk resources, try Sophisticated Storage Stack Upgrade Tier 1. It increases capacity per slot. This is a separate early upgrade, not a tier after the diamond chest.
Craft the module using JEI, hold it for the task, then place it in a container upgrade slot. Check the current pack tooltip for the resulting capacity and permitted combinations.

Reduce stored amounts to the normal capacity before removing the module. Chapter 37 continues with higher tiers, automation and the Controller. Sophisticated Backpacks modules have their own recipes and are not automatically interchangeable.
quest.5130113B8DF6EC22.title: Stack Upgrade: More Items per Slot
quest.5130113D2743CF28.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 4 × Networked Matching Pipe (classicpipes:matching_pipe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130113D2743CF28.title: Obtain 4 × Networked Matching Pipe
quest.5130113EBB472FCC.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Fluid Trash Can (extrautilitiesreborn:fluid_trash_can). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130113EBB472FCC.title: Obtain 1 × Fluid Trash Can
quest.51301141ECBD49DF.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Drawer Controller IO (storagedrawers:controller_io). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.51301141ECBD49DF.title: Obtain 1 × Drawer Controller IO
quest.5130114BF0614A92.quest_desc: An Ender Tank transfers fluid between tanks sharing a colour channel. Configure the pair, insert a small amount of the intended fluid and check it at the other end.
Use fluid pipes and provide extraction at the destination. An occupied channel is not a mixer for independent fluids; give water, fuel and other lines separate channels.
quest.5130114BF0614A92.title: Obtain 1 × Ender Tank
quest.5130115525AE2DB6.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 4 × Advanced Copper Pipe (classicpipes:advanced_copper_pipe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130115525AE2DB6.title: Obtain 4 × Advanced Copper Pipe
quest.5130115694DC485A.quest_desc: A single-compartment drawer holds a large supply of one item type. Choose a bulk resource, insert a sample and route that resource here; an ordinary chest suits assorted tools better.
Once its purpose is set, lock it with a Drawer Key. An emptied locked drawer retains its assigned type instead of taking an unrelated item from a mixed stream.
quest.5130115694DC485A.title: Obtain 1 × Oak Full Drawers 1
quest.5130115B118EE752.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Resonator (extrautilitiesreborn:resonator). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130115B118EE752.title: Obtain 1 × Resonator
quest.5130115C2448F78F.quest_desc: Start with a Sophisticated Storage wooden chest in chapter 37. A Copper Chest costs 8 copper blocks, or 72 ingots. The direct wooden-to-iron recipe uses a full Basic to Iron Tier Upgrade, which already pays for the copper tier.

Apply the matching Tier Upgrade to a placed chest with a right-click. Prepare 2 upgrades of the required tier for a double chest. Copper to Iron uses 8 iron blocks and a lever; Basic to Iron adds those blocks to a completed Basic to Copper upgrade.
The task detects one copper chest in your inventory without consuming it, regardless of wood or colour. Register it before placement. Functional upgrades and the Controller continue in chapter 37.
quest.5130115C2448F78F.title: Sophisticated Storage: Copper Chest

quest.5130115F8FB3D3A3.title: Obtain 4 × Networked Storage Pipe

quest.513011694AB3C2F8.title: Obtain 4 × Obsidian Pipe
quest.5130117C2D5AA079.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Oak Full Drawers 4 (storagedrawers:oak_full_drawers_4). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130117C2D5AA079.title: Obtain 1 × Oak Full Drawers 4
quest.5130117CBCB942CE.quest_desc: The Storage Downgrade reduces a drawer’s base capacity to one stack. It is an intentional limit for a small buffer or a stock with a defined upper bound.
Do not install it as another expansion for bulk storage. Remove excess contents first and check the resulting capacity; being placed in an upgrade slot does not mean an item increases storage.
quest.5130117CBCB942CE.title: Obtain 1 × Storage Downgrade
quest.5130117D90F459CC.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 1 × Furnace Generator (extrautilitiesreborn:furnace_generator). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.5130117D90F459CC.title: Obtain 1 × Furnace Generator
quest.51301185B7779201.quest_desc: Upgrade a Sophisticated Storage diamond chest to netherite. The pack recipe includes Radiation Shield and Control Assembly; the shield requires Desh from the Moon expedition.
Check the single or double chest recipe in JEI and prepare its materials. The native upgrade recipe retains container data; do not substitute an ordinary recipe that simply consumes a chest.
Hold one netherite chest to complete the non-consuming item task. Further capacity and automation come from modules and the Controller in chapter 37, within the same storage system.
quest.51301185B7779201.title: Netherite Chest: The Final Container Tier

quest.513011C12859CEF4.title: Obtain 1 × Upgrade Template
quest.513011C482A87300.quest_desc: Upgrade a Sophisticated Storage iron chest to gold. The pack recipe requires Precision Mechanism and Control Assembly, so prepare those production components first.
Compare the chest recipe and Iron to Gold Tier Upgrade in JEI. Native upgrade recipes retain container properties; use the matching upgrade kit for a placed chest.
Register the gold chest in your inventory without consuming it. The ME Drive recipe uses a separate Iron to Gold Tier Upgrade, so it cannot consume your filled storage chest.
quest.513011C482A87300.title: Gold Chest: A Larger Workshop Store
quest.513011D24B556B5D.quest_desc: Have in your inventory 4 × Oak Wooden Pipe (classicpipes:oak_pipe). The items are not consumed by this task.
quest.513011D24B556B5D.title: Obtain 4 × Oak Wooden Pipe
quest.513011DE65E3F4EE.quest_desc: A Compacting Drawer represents compatible forms of one resource as a shared supply, such as nuggets, ingots and blocks. Insert the intended material and inspect which forms it recognises.

Before automation, insert a small batch and withdraw another supported form. This is not a universal autocrafter: arbitrary machine recipes and multi-ingredient products are not unlocked by the drawer.
quest.513011DE65E3F4EE.title: Obtain 1 × Compacting Drawers (3-Tier)
quest.513011E12927F035.quest_desc: The Drawer Controller provides a common access point for a connected group of drawers. Assign drawers to the intended resources and check their connection to the controller before adding a shared input.
Locked samples help route bulk items into the right places. The controller does not provide unlimited storage of its own; a full destination drawer still requires a separate overflow plan.
quest.513011E12927F035.title: Obtain 1 × Drawer Controller
